architecture_layers.finding: load_and_verify_release_manifest verifies the full release payload before pre-handoff route evaluation. _iter_regular_files rejects symlink directories, symlink files and non-regular entries and re-hashes all admitted regular-file bytes. Ordinary package symlink substitution is therefore rejected upstream of WP1110/WP1111 consumer-specific path checks.

evaluate_pre_handoff_release delegates payload integrity to load_and_verify_release_manifest first. Its _resolve_declared_route still resolves before checking is_symlink at the observed snapshot, which is locally semantically weak but is not a second canonical payload-integrity authority. Separate R6-20260830-WP1110-ROUTE-SYMLINK-CONFINEMENT-GPT56SOL-01 owns that local route question.

WP1111 now walks every lexical path component and rejects symlinks before strict resolve and root/type checks. Because evaluate_portable_release_static_completeness first calls evaluate_pre_handoff_release, this protection is defense-in-depth for WP1111 metadata-reference semantics, not independent whole-release symlink authority.

negative_to_positive_reconciliation.reason: The first adversarial tests inserted symlinks into a fully manifested package and expected WP1111 BLOCKED receipts, but canonical release_integrity intercepted the invalid payload earlier. That test shape conflated upstream manifest authority with the consumer-local helper invariant.
negative_to_positive_reconciliation.repair: Trigger4 isolated the lexical-link falsifier as direct _safe_file/_load_json_file tests while preserving the full evaluator composition.

architecture_decision.test_law: Consumer-local path invariants should be unit-falsified at their own layer; composed full-release tests may assert fail-closed rejection at or before the consumer but must not require a lower layer to own an error already rejected by canonical upstream integrity.
do_not_do: do not make WP1111 a second whole-release integrity authority
do not weaken release_integrity merely to force a WP1111-specific error code
do not import openat2 or another filesystem framework for this frozen static gate
do not promote repository CI to clean-machine/runtime/completion credit

counterhypothesis: The WP1111 lexical check is redundant and should be deleted because release_integrity already rejects symlinks.
counterhypothesis_resolution: NOT_ADOPTED_AT_E2: the local check is low-cost, directly expresses the metadata-reference contract, protects helper reuse/isolated validation, and preserves a fail-closed invariant without creating a competing authority. Its tests must remain layer-scoped.
external_mechanism_boundary: Descriptor-relative/no-follow mechanisms such as Linux openat2 are relevant only to a separately claimed live mutable-filesystem/TOCTOU boundary. Static link-free-at-check-time evidence must not be inflated into atomic runtime file-identity guarantees.
integration_delta: NO_NEW_TRIGGER4_BUILD_REQUIRED_FROM_THIS_E2. Preserve the accepted WP1111 hardening and its layer-isolated regressions; route any WP1110 resolver issue and TOCTOU/file-identity issue to their separately claimed Trigger6 lanes.
next_exact_action: Re-enter current main and consume the separately owned WP1110 route-symlink and WP1111 TOCTOU results. Only emit a Trigger4 build candidate if either produces evidence that survives the upstream release_integrity authority boundary.
